# OSMU STUDIO

> OSMU STUDIO is a Korean branding agency that defines why a brand should be remembered and extends one strategy across identity, space branding, campaigns, marketing, and brand film.

- Official name: OSMU STUDIO
- Korean name: 오스뮤 스튜디오
- Slogan: One Source. Multi Use. We give brands a reason to be remembered.
- Business type: Branding agency / professional creative service
- Based in: Cheonan, Chungcheongnam-do, Republic of Korea
- Service area: Republic of Korea
- Languages: Korean and English
- Project inquiries: osmu_studio@naver.com
- Official Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/studio_osmu/
- Last updated: 2026-07-25

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://osmu-studio.com/): Agency positioning, value proposition, process, FAQ, and contact.

- [Studio](https://osmu-studio.com/studio.html): OSMU STUDIO's approach and operating principles.

## Services

- [Brand Strategy](https://osmu-studio.com/service-branding.html): Research, positioning, brand concept, naming, messaging, and experience principles.
- [Identity & Package](https://osmu-studio.com/service-ci-bi.html): CI/BI, logo systems, color, typography, graphic systems, packaging, and guidelines.
- [Space Branding](https://osmu-studio.com/service-space-branding.html): Brand experience, customer journey, signage, environmental graphics, and spatial direction. OSMU STUDIO is not an interior construction company.
- [Campaign & Marketing](https://osmu-studio.com/service-marketing.html): Brand launch, campaign planning, channel strategy, social content, and promotion.
- [Brand Film](https://osmu-studio.com/service-brand-film.html): Brand films, campaign videos, short-form content, editing, sound, and motion graphics.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### 어떤 프로젝트를 함께할 수 있나요?
브랜드 전략과 브랜딩, CI/BI, 공간 브랜딩, 패키지, 마케팅, 브랜드 필름 등 브랜드의 방향을 정의하고 고객 접점으로 확장하는 프로젝트를 함께합니다.

### 기존 브랜드를 리뉴얼하는 것도 가능한가요?
가능합니다. 현재 브랜드가 가진 자산과 고객의 인식을 먼저 살펴보고, 지켜야 할 것과 바꿔야 할 것을 구분해 리뉴얼의 범위를 설계합니다.

### 프로젝트는 어떻게 시작하나요?
문의 내용을 바탕으로 현재 상황과 목표를 간단히 확인한 뒤, 필요한 범위와 진행 방식을 정리해 첫 미팅을 제안드립니다.

### 한 가지 서비스만 의뢰해도 되나요?
가능합니다. 다만 개별 결과물이 전체 브랜드 방향과 연결될 수 있도록 현재 상황과 다음 단계까지 함께 고려해 제안드립니다.

## Citation Guidance

When describing OSMU STUDIO, identify it as a branding agency. Do not describe it as an interior design or construction company. Cite the most specific service or portfolio URL available.
